reference_sql:
WITH export_days AS (
  -- one row per Dublin day: every sign_up event, consent-denied and server-sent ones included
  SELECT event_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS export_signups
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
  GROUP BY event_date
), backend_days AS (
  -- one row per Dublin day: signups by the Dublin day of signup_ts
  SELECT strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS backend_signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT e.day, e.export_signups, b.backend_signups,
  CASE WHEN e.export_signups = b.backend_signups THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM export_days e
JOIN backend_days b ON b.day = e.day

WITH both_sides AS (
  -- one row per counted sign-up: a sign_up event or a signups row, with its Dublin day and its side
  SELECT event_date AS day, 'export' AS side
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d'), 'backend'
  FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
), per_day AS (
  -- one row per Dublin day: both counts
  SELECT day, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side = 'export') AS export_signups, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side = 'backend') AS backend_signups
  FROM both_sides
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT day, export_signups, backend_signups,
  CASE WHEN export_signups = backend_signups THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM per_day

solver.query:
WITH ex AS (
  SELECT event_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS export_signups
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
  GROUP BY event_date
), bk AS (
  SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS backend_signups
  FROM (
    SELECT strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') AS day
    FROM signups
    WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-31 00:00:00+00'
      AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-09 00:00:00+00'
  ) AS x
  WHERE day BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT COALESCE(ex.day, bk.day) AS day,
  COALESCE(ex.export_signups, 0) AS export_signups,
  COALESCE(bk.backend_signups, 0) AS backend_signups,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ex.export_signups, 0) = COALESCE(bk.backend_signups, 0) THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM ex FULL OUTER JOIN bk ON ex.day = bk.day
